blocks.text: A great hotel does more than give you a beautiful place to stay. It fully embraces you, providing the comfort of a home away from home, and gives you memories to carry with you. For Discovery Boracay, that has always been at the heart of the experience. Set along the powdery white sands of Station 1, Discovery Boracay has welcomed guests to the island for nearly two decades, combining a beachfront setting with spacious all-suite accommodations, thoughtful experiences, and the genuine warmth of Filipino hospitality. Today, the resort is honored to be among the hotels selected in the MICHELIN Guide 2026. […]... Keep on reading: Discovery Boracay earns a place in the MICHELIN Guide Hotels 2026
